name: City of Angles
description: Los Angeles, 1947. The war is over, but the shadows are just beginning.
seed_prompt: A hard-boiled noir setting of private eyes, femme fatales, and corruption that reaches the highest offices.
lore_content:
Los Angeles gleams under the California sun, but the city's heart is rotten. The studios control everything, the mob controls the studios, and nobody controls the dark impulses of the powerful.

Sam Marlowe runs a one-man detective agency out of a third-floor walkup on Wilshire. Ex-cop, ex-drunk, currently trying to stay both. He takes the cases the police won't touch - usually because touching them gets you killed.

Lilith Crane is the most dangerous woman in Hollywood. A former actress now married to studio head Victor Crane, she runs the Avalon Club, where the elite conduct business too dirty for boardrooms. She's hired Marlowe twice. Both times, people died.

Detective Rosa Valdez is one of three women on the LAPD and the only one who works homicides. The brass wants her to fail; the boys' club wants her gone. She solves cases anyway, usually the ones her colleagues are paid to bury.

Johnny Marcone owns the waterfront. The Marcone family ran booze during Prohibition and guns during the war. Now they're branching into legitimate business - which means buying politicians and breaking anyone who won't sell.

Victor Crane controls Olympus Pictures and half the scandals in Hollywood. Starlets who cross him disappear. Stars who expose him have accidents. He keeps files on everyone, insurance against a world that might someday turn on him.

Lorelei Lake was the biggest star in Hollywood until the scandal. Now she lives in a Malibu estate, drinking herself to death. She claims she's writing her memoirs. The studio claims they'll destroy her if she publishes. Someone hired Marlowe to find out which way she'll jump.

Down in Central Avenue, the jazz clubs keep playing despite the segregation, despite the raids. Singer Ella Divine knows secrets she's never told anyone. She watched a movie star commit murder ten years ago. Now that star is running for Congress, and Ella has started receiving threats.

origins.name: Street Kid
origins.description: You grew up on the tough streets of Los Angeles, learning to survive by your wits and fists.
traits: Quick Reflexes: You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects you can see.
languages: One additional language of your choice

origins.name: War Veteran
origins.description: You served your country overseas and returned to Los Angeles, forever changed by the horrors you witnessed.
traits: Iron Will: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

origins.name: Blue Blood
origins.description: You were born into wealth and privilege, insulated from the grime and grit of the city.
traits: Silver Tongue: You have advantage on Persuasion checks made to influence people of high social standing.

origins.name: Immigrant
origins.description: You came to Los Angeles seeking a better life, but found a city of broken dreams and hard choices.
traits: Resilient: You have advantage on saving throws against disease and poison.

origins.name: Hollywood Hopeful
origins.description: You came to Los Angeles with stars in your eyes, ready to make it big in the movie industry.
traits: Star Quality: When interacting with someone who is starstruck or impressed by your apparent fame, you have advantage on Charisma checks.

archetypes.name: Private Eye
archetypes.description: A hard-boiled investigator who navigates the dark underbelly of Los Angeles, uncovering secrets and confronting dangerous criminals.

features.name: Gut Feeling
features.description: At 1st level, you can use a bonus action to gain advantage on your next Wisdom (Streetwise) or Wisdom (Perception) check.

archetypes.name: Mob Enforcer
archetypes.description: A brutal and intimidating figure who works for organized crime, enforcing the mob's will through violence and intimidation.

features.name: Intimidating Presence
features.description: You gain proficiency in the Intimidation skill. If you are already proficient, you add double your proficiency bonus to any check you make that uses Intimidation.

archetypes.name: Femme Fatale
archetypes.description: A seductive and manipulative woman who uses her charm and beauty to get what she wants, often leading men to their doom.
starting_equipment: A compact mirror with a hidden knife

features.name: Alluring Gaze
features.description: As an action, choose one creature you can see within 30 feet of you. If the creature can see you, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) or be charmed by you until the end of your next turn. While charmed in this way, the creature is considered friendly to you.

archetypes.name: Beat Cop
archetypes.description: A police officer dedicated to upholding the law, patrolling the streets and dealing with the daily grind of crime and corruption.

features.name: Uphold the Law
features.description: You gain advantage on Persuasion checks made to convince someone to cooperate with law enforcement.

archetypes.name: Whiskey Priest
archetypes.description: A conflicted clergyman struggling with their faith in a world of sin and despair, offering solace and guidance to those who need it most.

features.name: Comfort the Afflicted
features.description: When you spend at least 1 minute speaking to a willing creature that is frightened or distressed, you can attempt to calm them. The creature makes a Wisdom saving throw (DC 10 or the DC of the effect that caused the condition, whichever is higher). On a success, the frightened condition ends.

setting_skills.name: Studio Politics
setting_skills.description: Understanding Hollywood's power dynamics — who controls which studio, who owes whom, what scandals are being buried, and whose career is one photograph away from ruin.

setting_skills.name: Mob Connections
setting_skills.description: Navigating organized crime networks. Knowing who to approach in the Marcone family, what debts are owed, and the etiquette that keeps you from ending up in the river.

setting_skills.name: LAPD Politics
setting_skills.description: Knowing which cops are clean, which are bought, and how to work the department's internal politics. Understanding what gets buried, what gets leaked, and who decides.

setting_skills.name: The Jazz Circuit
setting_skills.description: Access to Central Avenue's jazz scene, where secrets flow as freely as the music. The clubs operate across the color line, creating both barriers and hiding places for those who know the scene.
